abstract: The risk of developing choriocarcinoma following a complete hydatidiform mole (CHM) is 2000-4000 times greater than the risk following a normal pregnancy. To understand more fully the increased susceptibility of the molar trophoblast to malignant transformation, we separated the trophoblastic cells from the stromal cells in 14 complete moles and cultured them for cytogenetic analysis. The numerical and structural abnormalities found were compared with those found in the trophoblasts from normal pregnancy and malignant choriocarcinoma cell lines. The percentage of polyploid cells was 2.8 times greater in molar trophoblasts than in normal trophoblasts. Although we found no consistent chromosomal abnormality in the molar trophoblasts, these cells were significantly more vulnerable to chromosomal breakage than the molar fibroblasts, normal trophoblasts, normal fibroblasts, and maternal decidual cells. Out of a total of 103 breakpoints observed in 338 cells, 42 coincided with known fragile sites, 18 with the location of protooncogenes, 27 with breakpoints reported in other neoplasia, and 18 with breakpoints found in four choriocarcinoma cell lines. The chromosomes in choriocarcinoma cell lines have hypotetraploid mode and many structural rearrangements. Our results suggest that the genetic instability found in the molar trophoblasts may be responsible for progressive karyotypic changes and greater susceptibility to malignant transformation.
abstract_ja: 完全奇胎（CHM）後に絨毛癌を発症するリスクは、正常妊娠後と比べて2000〜4000倍高い。胞状奇胎の栄養膜細胞が悪性転化しやすい理由をより深く理解するため、14例の完全奇胎から栄養膜細胞と間質細胞を分離し、細胞遺伝学的解析のために培養した。正常妊娠の栄養膜細胞と比較して、奇胎栄養膜細胞の倍数体細胞の割合は2.8倍高かった。奇胎栄養膜細胞に一貫した染色体異常は認められなかったが、これらの細胞は、奇胎線維芽細胞、正常栄養膜細胞、正常線維芽細胞、母体の脱落膜細胞と比べて有意に染色体切断を受けやすかった。338細胞中で観察された103の切断点のうち、42か所は既知の脆弱部位と、18か所は癌遺伝子の位置と、27か所は他の腫瘍で報告された切断点と、18か所は4種類の絨毛癌細胞株で見られた切断点と一致した。絨毛癌細胞株の染色体は低四倍体のモードを示し、多くの構造異常を有していた。以上の結果から、奇胎栄養膜細胞に認められるゲノム不安定性が、進行性の核型変化およびより高い悪性転化感受性の原因となっている可能性が示唆された。
